selection_rules.internal_representative_correct: One correct sample per shared-8 true class. Select the sample whose confidence is closest to the class-specific median confidence. Tie-break by sample_id ascending.
selection_rules.internal_relative_lowest_confidence: Select the three lowest-confidence correct internal shared-8 samples. This is a relative internal low-confidence category and is not equivalent to confidence < 0.70.
selection_rules.external_representative_correct: For every external true class containing at least one correct prediction, select one correct sample closest to the class-specific median correct confidence. Tie-break by sample_id ascending.
selection_rules.external_representative_incorrect: For every external shared true class containing an error, select one incorrect sample closest to the class-specific median error confidence. Tie-break by sample_id ascending.
selection_rules.external_high_confidence_correct: Among correct external predictions with confidence >= 0.90, select the five highest-confidence cases. Tie-break by sample_id ascending.
selection_rules.external_high_confidence_incorrect: Among incorrect external predictions with confidence >= 0.90, select the five highest-confidence errors. Tie-break by sample_id ascending.
selection_rules.external_low_confidence: Among external predictions with confidence < 0.70, select the five lowest-confidence cases. Tie-break by sample_id ascending.

duplicate_policy: A sample selected by multiple rules appears once in the unique XAI cohort; every role membership is preserved in a separate membership table.
